definitions.explanation: The scents and essential oils of aromatherapy; also a short form of aromatherapy itself. In food and drink writing, the aroma of coffee or wine.

examples.japanese: アロマ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焚|た}く→焚く：02285_taku⟧。
アロマ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦リラックス→リラックス：02531_rirakkusu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I relax with the scent of aroma oils.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ラベンダー→ラベンダー：30768_rabendaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧アロマオイル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{数滴|すうてき}⟦{垂|た}らす→垂らす：05339_tarasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れる→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: A few drops of lavender oil before bed help me sleep well.

notes:
From English "aroma," but in Japanese it usually means the essential oils and scents of aromatherapy (アロマテラピー) rather than any pleasant smell.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アロマオイル: essential oil
- アロマ⟦キャンドル→キャンドル：28904_kyandoru⟧: scented candle
- アロマディフューザー: diffuser
- アロマ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焚|た}く→焚く：02285_taku⟧: to burn aroma oil

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: fragrance — the general native word
- ⟦フレグランス→フレグランス：31326_fureguransu⟧: fragrance, perfume products
